title: YouTube comments under BMW 5 Series (G60) review videos, IT search market

sampling.method: YouTube Data API: search.list (relevance, 10 per query, region IT, language it), title filter for the vehicle, then commentThreads newest first, up to 3 pages of 100 threads per video plus the replies the API includes; scrapers/youtube_comments.py
sampling.query: BMW Serie 5 G60 prova | BMW i5 prova su strada | BMW Serie 5 2024 recensione
limitations: Market is the search market (region + relevance language), not the commenter's location.
17 videos selected by search relevance and a title pattern; not a random sample of owners.
Up to 3 pages of comment threads per video; replies beyond the 5 the API returns per thread are missing.
Videos whose language tags all differ from the market language were dropped.
Reply/thread links, like counts and video titles are kept in the warehouse but have no field in schema v1 source_fields.
subject_id bmw:G60 also covers Touring (G61), i5 and M5 videos.

provenance.notes: Collected with scrapers/youtube_comments.py (spec docs/specs/youtube-scraper.md). Commenter names and channel ids are not stored.

export_permissions.notes: Unresolved: scraped third-party review text; keep out of Git and external LLMs until decided.
